input.oldString:
# Get repository info
    repo_info=$(pacman -Qi "$pkg" 2>/dev/null | grep "Repository" | awk '{print $3}')
    
    if [[ -z "$repo_info" ]]; then
        repo_info="AUR/Unknown"
    fi
input.newString:
# Get repository info
    repo_info=$(pacman -Qi "$pkg" 2>/dev/null | grep "Installed From" | awk '{print $3}')
    
    if [[ -z "$repo_info" ]]; then
        repo_info="AUR/Unknown"
    fi
